exposure: conservative surgery for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
Conservative surgery for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
cohort: Two groups of pregnant women: those with previous conservative surgery for PAS and those with a history of cesarean section
finding: While conservative surgery for PAS is surgically challenging, it appears feasible for fertility preservation, with comparable fetal outcomes to pregnancies after cesarean section but higher risk of postpartum transfusion and urinary tract infections.
mod_finding: This study examined subsequent pregnancies after conservative surgery for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) and found it feasible, though associated with higher rates of postpartum transfusions and urinary tract infections.
